in_marathi.name: Ajaykumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajaykumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajaykumar is derived from Sanskrit roots, 'aj' meaning 'invincible' or 'unconquerable' and 'kumar' meaning 'younger brother' or 'prince'. This name was borne by several legendary figures in Hindu mythology, symbolizing strength, courage, and leadership.
